column1: # project-charters.tsv — every multi-session project must say what DONE looks like.
# Registered here, a project gets a force function: charter-read.sh prints its board at
# student-in and stamps the session ledger, and gate step G-AL FAILs at wrap for a session
# that never read it. Unregistered projects are reported by G-AL as a WARN, never silence --
# "no definition of done" is a finding, not a default.
# The key is matched loosely: a session slug has its trailing -NN stripped, is lowercased,
# and non-alphanumerics are dropped. So acmeLedger-26, acme-ledger-25 and acmeledger all
# resolve to the same row. (The estate learned this the hard way -- braatzio-plan was once
# acme-ledger-plan, the session IDs never changed, and a path symlink papers over the rest.)
# ⚠ COLUMN 4 MUST BE ONE SIMPLE COMMAND — no redirect, no ';', no '&&'.
# gate-selfcheck reads it as `_ch_brief="$(eval echo "<col4>")"`. An `>/dev/null` anywhere in
# the column redirects THE ECHO ITSELF, so _ch_brief comes back EMPTY and G-AL#board reports
# "CANNOT VERIFY: neither gen-done.py nor a board.py brief command in the charter registry" --
# which reads as "this project has no board" when the board is fine and the CELL is broken.
# Found 2026-09-14 (curieOnboard-01); it had been silently disarming flowerdrift's board check
# too. NOTE (smBacklog-15, 2026-09-20, from lineup-01's FF-2 finding 1789900291-cf92): --brief
# NEVER WRITES, even with --out (braatzMail-120 ruling in board.py: a display command must
# not edit a tracked file behind the reader; --brief + --out prints the board and, if the
# file is stale, a WARNING with the exact regenerate command). So column 4 with --brief is
# the DISPLAY command only; G-AL#board's remediation is the same command MINUS --brief.
# One registered command, two jobs, and the second one is the printed remediation.
# 6bnCanary and freshCanary are ONE project. Registered under the slug sessions actually
# use (freshCanary); the criteria/DoD files carry the 6bnCanary name. Do NOT add a second
# row for 6bnCanary -- two rows rendering one CHECKLIST is a board-path collision and
# G-AL#board then judges one project's board against the other's criteria, STALE forever.
# (Caught by G-AL#registry within the hour of the first registration, 2026-09-10.)
